name: Garland

neighborhoods.name: Downtown Garland
neighborhoods.homes: older houses and new apartments near the DART station

housing: Garland's rentals are mostly brick single-family homes from the 1960s to 1980s and garden-style apartment complexes.

localRules.text: Owners of single-family homes and duplexes rented out in Garland must register them and hold a permit from Code Compliance under Chapter 32 of the city code.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters

climate: Test the air conditioning and look for foundation cracks, sticking doors and hail damage; North Texas heat, clay soils and spring storms cause all three.
fact: Garland requires a city permit for single-family rental homes, so a landlord should be able to show one.
